title.narrative: The Australian Volunteers Program-global development cooperation-July 2017-June 2027

description.narrative: The Australian Volunteers Program deploys Australians who volunteer their skills through assignments with overseas partners across 26 countries in the Pacific, Asia and Africa across diverse sectors including health, education, disability and gender inclusion, climate, economic growth and recovery. The goal of the program is that global volunteering supports locally led change and the realisation of the Sustainable Development Goals. The program is delivered by Australian Volunteers International (AVI) in consortium with DT Global and Alinea International.
